source_notes: Compiled from the National Endowment for the Arts' official NEA National Heritage Fellows directory (https://www.arts.gov/honors/heritage and https://www.arts.gov/honors/heritage/list, all 502 fellowship profile pages, 1982-2026, fetched Oct 2026), which is the authoritative source for name, year, tradition/art-form label, and residence city+state at time of award (each profile page's header gives 'YEAR NEA National Heritage Fellow | City, State'). Includes Bess Lomax Hawes Award recipients (given since 2000 to advocates/folklorists/presenters rather than performing artists; these are tagged category='other' unless their tradition statement names a specific art form). Wikipedia's 'National Heritage Fellowship' article was used as a secondary cross-check on names/years/traditions. Of the 502 official fellowship awards, 21 were joint awards to two or three named individuals (married couples, siblings, or duos such as 'Jim & Jesse McReynolds' or the three Gee's Bend quilters) rather than to a single named performing group; those 21 awards were split into 43 separate per-person fellow records so that 'every fellow' (person) is listed individually, each sharing the same year/tradition/url as the joint award. Named performing groups/ensembles/bands (e.g. Los Lobos, Excelsior Band, Ukrainian Bandurist Chorus of North America) were kept as single collective records. This yields 524 total fellow records from 502 fellowships. Metro assignment: residence city was geocoded against the 2023 Census Gazetteer place file (centroid lat/long) and tested by point-in-polygon against county boundaries (Census counties.geojson) for the specific counties listed in the 20-metro CBSA county crosswalk supplied for this task (2023 CBSA delineation). ~29 residences used in NYC boroughs/neighborhoods not separately listed in the Census place file (e.g. Astoria/Corona/Flushing/Bayside = Queens; Brooklyn = Kings Co.; Bronx = Bronx Co.; Staten Island = Richmond Co.) and a handful of other towns (e.g. Delaplane VA -> Fauquier Co., in washington-dc; Onamia MN -> Mille Lacs Co., in minneapolis; Oakland/Castro Valley CA -> Alameda Co., in san-francisco; several NJ/PA suburbs -> new-york or philadelphia via their county) were resolved manually by county lookup since they are not incorporated Census 'places'. San Jose CA, Boulder CO, Ann Arbor MI, Baltimore MD, and Connecticut residences are correctly excluded from san-francisco/denver/detroit/washington-dc/new-york respectively, per the supplied county crosswalk. 'category' is a broad classification inferred from the NEA tradition/art-form label via keyword rules with manual review of ambiguous cases (Bess Lomax Hawes honorees, bandleaders, tea-ceremony/ritual arts, etc.).
